description: Read buy and sell quotes for a Robinhood Chain (4663) stock token, for example TSLA or NVDA, at $100, $1k and $10k on every route Otto reads. Each route gives the expected output, LI.FI’s minimum where it has one, the effective price and the premium or discount to the underlying stock’s last price, and the best of the routes read is named; a best route far worse than the $100 quote is flagged `large_price_impact`, and the premium is withheld when the reference listing is not the token’s company. A saved quote served because no live read finished is labelled with its age. Nothing to sign; quotes are before gas and prices move with the market. A token the route does not quote is refused and nothing is charged. Paid-only, including the first call. Not investment advice. Hosted access: paid-only; each call costs $0.003 USDC through x402 and preserves the free allowance.

token.description: Robinhood Chain stock token: its ticker, for example TSLA or NVDA, or its token address on Robinhood Chain (4663).

x_payment.description: Signed x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive the machine-actionable payment challenge, then retry with the signed payload.
